tS.text: The new controls in use (drawn with lens 1)

sV.text:
Same moment in all five: fighting, 2 unread, hot keys shown.

No strip at the top any more. Three small keys sit on the lens: top left opens the pane strip, top right is fullscreen, bottom right is Comm with the unread count.

Above the compass: K1, K2, K3, round and see-through. The key left of N folds them away.

The five differ only in the ring's texture and the glass.

sS.text:
Strip: opened by the lens's top left key; swipe sideways to change pane; the fight card sits right under it.

Hold a hot key for a second to change it: type a command or pick one. Wimpy at half of current HP is a special pick that reads your HP when pressed.

The lens hides whenever something would collide with it, and comes back when there is room.
